item.title: Little Rock official highlights difference between 911 and 311 after string of calls mixing both up
item.description: Little Rock 911 Operations officials say they have been getting non-emergency and administrative calls that should have been going to the city’s 311 Services, and vice versa.

item.title: Girl Scout cookies at Park Plaza this weekend
item.description: Girl Scout Troop 6235 and 6487 will be selling Girl Scout cookies at Park Plaza Mall in Little Rock this Saturday and Sunday, with a variety of classic and new flavors available, including the new Exploremores cookie.

item.title: Arkansas school districts cut ties with photography company Lifetouch amid online Epstein claims, Lifetouch denies rumors
item.description: Amid growing concerns from parents and online speculation about alleged ties to the Epstein files, the South Conway County School District has cut ties with school photography company Lifetouch, a decision one Morrilton mother said puts student safety first.

item.title: Sherwood providing confidential counseling for first responders
item.description: The City of Sherwood has entered into a new agreement with the Arkansas Municipal League aimed at expanding confidential mental health services for public safety employees.

item.title: AST Blog: Good News for Northern Arkansas...
item.description: Long range guidance has been hinting at a more active, progressive pattern, and the 8 to 14 day outlook is leaning toward above average precipitation for our part of the country in the March 5 to 11 window.

item.title: 'Do the right thing', Pulaski County Sheriff's Office and father of shooting victim asking for public's help
item.description: Early Saturday morning, 35-year-old Ricky Manning was shot and killed in front of his home in the community of College Station. His father, also named Ricky, said his family is well-known and well-loved throughout the community. He doesn't understand why anybody would have attacked his son.

item.title: Wednesday's Child: Meet Tara, a 17-year-old hoping to connect with a forever family
item.description: Growing up in the foster care system, without a family, can be a very lonely place. Sadly, being alone is all this week's Wednesday's child has ever known. Her wish is to find the love and connection she has always wanted and deserves.

item.title: 'It’s fear, it’s anger, it’s distrust,' Batesville community rattled from investigation into claims of abuse at the preschool
item.description: After Batesville police confirmed an investigation into abuse at a local preschool, the community is in an uproar.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Arkansas delegation voices support after President Trump’s State of the Union address
item.description: The all-Republican Arkansas delegation voiced support for President Donald Trump's State of the Union address, citing issues such as security, borders and the economy.
